edit.engine: FFmpeg libx264 CPU encoding, one encode at a time through shared renderlock.py, maximum 3 encoder threads.
edit.loop: Source frames 24..367 play first; the final 24 output frames dissolve over one second into source frames 0..23. Browser replay advances from that head into source frame 24. No hard-cut tail or frozen hold.
edit.transition_note: The one-second wrap is a conventional soft dissolve, including natural double exposure during the blend. It is not an invisible match-moved transition.
edit.grading: Subtle contrast 1.035 and saturation 1.035; native color otherwise preserved. No synthetic scenery, logos, text or credit overlays.
